title: PHI-Safe, LLM-Oriented Code Books for Data Frames
text: Compact, machine-parseable code books data frames, designed pasted large language model prompt model can write correct code dataset without ever seeing row-level data. Human-facing codebook packages optimise readability. codebookLLM optimises model write dplyr, ggplot2 modelling code: one line per variable, explicit role tags, short list gotchas (numbers stored text, unused factor levels, candidate primary keys, duplicate rows).

PHI-Safe, LLM-Oriented Code Books for Data Frames
code: library(codebookLLM)  df <- data.frame(   patient_mrn = sprintf("M%05d", 1:20),   age = rep(c(55, 61, 70, 48), 5),   sex = factor(rep(c("F", "M"), 10)),   visit_date = as.Date("2020-01-01") + 1:20 )  llm_codebook(df) #> # Codebook: df #> #> - rows: 20 #> - columns: 4 #> - class: data.frame #> - complete rows: 20 (100.0%) #> - detail level: safe (row-level data withheld) #> #> ## Variables #> #> | variable | class | role | n_missing | %missing | n_distinct | values / summary | notes | #> |---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---| #> | `patient_mrn` | character | id | 0 | 0 | 20 | <unique identifier: values withheld> | flagged as possible direct identifier | #> | `age` | numeric | numeric | 0 | 0 | 4 | ~range=[48, 70] ~median=58 | only 4 distinct values; may be categorical | #> | `sex` | factor | binary | 0 | 0 | 2 | ["F", "M"] |  | #> | `visit_date` | Date | date | 0 | 0 | 20 | range=[2020-01, 2020-01] | unique in every row | llm_codebook(df, format = "yaml")                    # terse, prompt-friendly llm_codebook(df, format = "json") llm_codebook(df, detail = "structure")               # types and missingness only llm_codebook(df, detail = "full")                    # exact numeric summaries llm_codebook(df, file = "codebook.md")               # write to disk llm_codebook(df, labels = c(age = "Age at surgery")) # attach descriptions
